name: Penpot
description: Open source design and prototyping platform.
summary: Responsible AI use is supported for issues, PRs and other submissions, as long as a human carefully reviews and verifies AI-assisted content before submitting it.

evidence.quote: We support the responsible use of AI tools in the development process.
Submit AI-generated code without human review.
all contributions to Penpot - including issues, pull requests, and any other submissions - must meet a reasonable standard of quality, accuracy, and human oversight.
If AI-assisted content is used, it must be carefully reviewed and verified by a human before submission.
